title: Gratin Portuguese Tomato Casserole
description: A flavorful and colorful casserole perfect for a hearty vegan meal. This dish combines the richness of the gratin with the freshness of tomatoes and the elegance of a perfectly baked casserole.

ingredients.name: gratin cheese substitute (vegan)
ingredients.notes: such as tofu cream or soy cheese

instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
In a separate bowl, combine the sliced eggplant and halved tomatoes. Toss with the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the eggplant and tomato mixture. Top with a layer of the cooked onion and garlic mixture.
Repeat the layering process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of the eggplant and tomato mixture on top.
Sprinkle the vegan gratin cheese substitute evenly over the top layer.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
